The coefficient of x18 in the expansion of (2+x3)10 is

a
 210
b
 1680
c
 420
d
 5040
e
 3360
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The binomial theorem states that for any positive integer n, we have (a+b)n=(n0)anb0+(n1)an−1b1+(n2)an−2b2+…+(nn)a0bn.

In the case of (2+x3)10, we have a=2, b=x3, and n=10. Therefore, (2+x3)10=(100)210(x3)0+(101)210−1(x3)1+(102)210−2(x3)2+⋯+(1010)210−10(x3)10.

From here, we see that the x18 term must be (106)210−6(x3)6.

Simplifying this term, we get (106)210−6(x3)6=210⋅24⋅x18=210⋅16⋅x18=3360x18.

Therefore, the coefficient of x18 is 3360.
